producer: capsulectl and capsulectl-deal built from git archive of capsule-cli main 8eff953 (feat(deal): a sale's listing post, #398; the first commit with capsule-cli #391, the user's own attributed authenticity claim) with CGO_ENABLED=0 go build -trimpath (capsulectl --version: capsulectl 0.1.0-dev (commit unknown); no release carries attributed_to yet).

sources.sale.bundle.json, check-inputs/{a-attrib: out/ of a script in capsule-engine tests/fixtures/release-on-acceptance/build.sh's style, run with that capsulectl and deal plugin, materiality builtin:neutral, on a throwaway HOME, XDG_CONFIG_HOME and plugin root, with a local stub rules checker that records each external-check-input/v0 and allows. One sale (deal sale new) whose intent orders one class seller 0.1.5's s04 lists under requires_approval (intent.ordered_representations), two buyer threads (deal open --sale). On A, deal check --input of a represent check of that ordered class (ordered), of the user's own authenticity claim {"class":"authenticity","text":"The seller says it's authentic (unverified)","attributed_to":"user"} (attributed), of the agent's own authenticity claim (own-authenticity), of delivery_date, not ordered (unordered), and of condition; on B, the ordered class and the attributed claim. Each check that did not pass got the user's proceed approval (deal note --kind approval). The claims of A's ordered, attributed and condition checks and of B's ordered check were noted against their checks (deal note --kind claim --check), so the threads' deal reports open their words; B's attributed claim was never noted. Then deal sale bundle. Nothing was sent anywhere.
sources.check-inputs/a-attributed-*.json, a-orde: live-only edits of a-attributed.json, a-ordered.json and a-unordered.json, each record re-bound to its edited agent_input (agent_action_capsule.json_digest): the attributed words rewritten with their text_commitment recomputed under the same nonce (no suffix, two sentences, an ellipsis, a line separator, a claim of U+001F or U+00A0 alone, another script, the prefix and suffix alone); the opening's nonce wrong, removed, null or a list; the opening's text with a lone surrogate escape; the commitment malformed, null or removed; attributed_to "User"; the class features; no task_authority_ref; and the task authority's ordered list with a number, with an unknown class, not a list, or empty, with task_authority_record and the ref's digest updated together.
